notes: Page titles: 'Smoothering Pancakes' and 'Heavenly Crepes'. Branded with 'Junktion77 - The Foodies' Crossroads' logo top-right (not Gluttons Garage branding). Olive/khaki-brown background with faint gear/cog pattern; headings in cream decorative calligraphic/ornamental serif; item names in bold tan/gold serif; descriptions in small white sans-serif; prices right-aligned in tan with '/-' suffix. Section intros: Pancakes - 'There is hardship in everything except having a sumptous pancake. 2 nos served with one shot of whipped cream.' Crepes - 'Happiness is.... tasting loads of crepes'. No veg/non-veg dot markers on this page (veg flags inferred only from meat names). Toppings heading in orange/gold. Bottom: circular photos of chocolate pancake stack and a cheese-topped crepe. No tax/charges text. Fully legible.
